title: The Flush That Goes Up
spec: Flush the toilet. Instead of draining, the water slowly rises toward the rim. You watch it climb, waiting for it to finally go down.

title: Ten Monsters, One Hundred Players
spec: Accept a quest to defeat ten monsters. Arrive at the quest area and find a crowd surrounding every spawn point. Your counter remains at 0/10.

title: The Mystery Smoke Alarm
spec: Replace the battery in a chirping smoke alarm. Enjoy a moment of silence—then hear another chirp coming from the locked room next door.

title: The Untouchable Fly
spec: Follow a fly across the ceiling and prepare the perfect swat. It escapes at the last moment and lands directly on your nose.

title: The Sales Call Timing
spec: Finally sit down to relax. Your phone rings with a sales call. End the conversation, put the phone down, and another unknown number starts calling.

title: The Stone in Your Shoe
spec: Feel a tiny stone under your foot. Remove the shoe and shake it thoroughly. Put it back on, take three steps, and feel the stone again.

title: The Wobbly Table
spec: Set a drink on the table and rest your arm beside it. The table rocks. Stabilize one corner, and the opposite corner starts moving instead.

title: The Unreachable Itch
spec: An itch appears in the exact middle of your back. Reach over your shoulder, then around your waist. Your fingertips stop just short every time.

title: The Stolen Parking Space
spec: Circle a full car park until you finally spot someone leaving. Approach the empty space, and another driver slips into it just before you.

title: Almost the Same Outfit
spec: Carefully choose an outfit for an event. Arrive and find another guest wearing almost exactly the same thing. You end up standing together in the photo.

title: The Best Clothes, Immediately Stained
spec: Put on your finest outfit and admire it in the mirror. Pick up a drink before leaving and spill a small, very visible splash down the front.

title: The One-Treatment Military Clinic
spec: Choose a complaint at the military clinic. Whatever option you select, the medic hands over the same basic painkillers and points you back toward duty.

title: The Ticket App at the Bus Door
spec: Reach the front of the boarding queue and realize you still need a ticket. Open the app. A loading spinner turns while the driver and everyone behind you wait.

title: The Actor on Every Channel
spec: Change channels to watch something different. The same actor appears in a drama, a detective series, and then the next advertisement.

title: That Catchphrase Again
spec: Hear an advertising slogan you are tired of. Switch to another program. During its next break, the same slogan returns in a slightly different advertisement.

title: Ten Minutes Before the Ending
spec: Reach the final ten minutes of a film. Your eyelids keep closing. Fight to stay awake, then open your eyes to the end credits.

title: The Expired Certificate
spec: Open the website you maintain, expecting its normal homepage. A security warning fills the screen instead. The certificate expired today.

title: The Shoelace That Won’t Stay Tied
spec: Tie your shoelaces neatly and start walking. After a few steps, one bow comes undone and the loose lace drags along the ground.

title: The Resealable Bag That Won’t Seal
spec: Press along a bag’s resealable strip from one end to the other. Reach the end and discover that the first half has already popped open.

title: The Freshly Washed Car
spec: Finish washing your car and polish away the final water spot. Step back to admire it. A bird leaves a fresh splat in the middle of the windshield.

title: The Blanket That’s Slightly Too Short
spec: Pull a blanket over your shoulders, exposing your feet. Cover your feet, and your shoulders become cold. Keep adjusting without finding a position that covers both.

title: The Shopping Cart’s Bad Wheel
spec: Take a shopping cart and push it straight ahead. One wheel rattles and pulls sideways. Correct its direction, and it immediately drifts toward the shelf again.
